caption: Timothy Leary, undated press photograph, circa 1969.
alt: Black-and-white close-up portrait of a middle-aged man with shoulder-length gray-streaked hair, looking directly at the camera.
credit: Photo by James Klepitsch, published in the Chicago Daily News, via Wikimedia Commons
note: The Crimson article itself is still under copyright, so no page of it is used. This is a press portrait of Timothy Leary, the subject (not the author) of the piece, from about six years after the 1963 events it describes; Commons carries it as public domain but does not name the original photographer.
